what.en: A Latin history of the Danes that retells many of the same figures as human kings and heroes.

adds.en: Other versions of the stories of Baldr (Balderus) and Hamlet (Amlethus).

differs.en: Baldr is a warrior killed in battle by Høtherus, not by the mistletoe.

what.en: A prose saga of the Völsungs that tells the whole story of Sigurðr, Brynhildr and Guðrún in order.

adds.en: The parts of the story lost with the missing leaves of the Codex Regius.

differs.en: Details of Sigurðr's death and Brynhildr's vows differ between the saga and the poems.
